location: p. 33, Individual differences in the tendency to mention women and related variables (see also p. 21, Confirmatory Analysis)
quote:
In line with the original study (Stahlberg et al., 2001), one significant variable was
participant sex. That is, independently of the condition participants were in, women named more
women than men did.
reason: Document identity (Brohmer et al., 2024, OSF q56rk accepted confirmatory report) and target effect (main effect of participant sex on the number of women named in the close-replication 2 x 3 ANOVA, p. 21) are independently verified. In the discussion of individual differences (p. 33), the authors explicitly state that women named more women than men did in line with the original study (Stahlberg et al., 2001), confirming an effect-specific successful replication verdict.
